N001.summary: At the start of the game, the focus is on establishing a strong economy and technology base. Production is moderate, and the army composition is not yet defined. Maintain your current economic and technology development path. Continue producing workers and investing in technology structures. Keep your options open for army composition.
N001.title: Early Game Technology Focus
N001.trigger_summary: At the start of the game, the focus is on establishing a strong economy and technology base. Production is moderate, and the army composition is not yet defined.

N002.summary: As the game progresses into the early midgame, you begin to define your army composition. Production becomes heavy, and you start producing ground units. Continue producing a ground-based army with Stalkers, Sentries, and Immortals. Use Observers for vision and to detect hidden threats. Maintain your economic and technology development.
N002.title: Midgame Transition to Ground Army
N002.trigger_summary: As the game progresses into the early midgame, you begin to define your army composition. Production becomes heavy, and you start producing ground units.

N003.summary: In the midgame, your army composition is now well-defined with a mix of Zealots, Stalkers, Sentries, and Observers. Production is heavy, and you are maintaining a strong economy. Continue producing your ground army and maintain your economy. Consider adding more expansions to support your production. Use Observers to scout and detect incoming threats.
N003.title: Midgame Army Consolidation
N003.trigger_summary: In the midgame, your army composition is now well-defined with a mix of Zealots, Stalkers, Sentries, and Observers. Production is heavy, and you are maintaining a strong economy.

N004.summary: In the late midgame, you have secured additional expansions and your economy is strong. Your army is well-developed and you are in a stable position. Continue to produce units and maintain your economy. Consider adding more production structures if needed. Use your Observers to keep vision on the map and detect any opponent movements.
N004.title: Late Midgame Expansion and Stability
N004.trigger_summary: In the late midgame, you have secured additional expansions and your economy is strong. Your army is well-developed and you are in a stable position.
